criteria.criterion: Navigate Xbox.com to the 'Best sellers' section
criteria.final_justification: Given the lack of any visual evidence of a “Best sellers” section/list being reached or identified, the baseline score should not be increased. The agent did scroll and navigate to /games (effort), so some partial credit remains appropriate, but not more than baseline.

criteria.criterion: Open a product page for a game from 'Best sellers'
criteria.final_justification: The agent did open a valid Xbox product page (confirmed), but provenance from “Best sellers” is not visually established. Keep the baseline partial credit rather than full credit.

criteria.criterion: Report publisher, developer, and release date from the product page
criteria.final_justification: All three required fields are visible in the evidence, but the agent failed to report the publisher and made a contradicted claim about its absence. This is a controllable miss, so the score should be reduced from baseline partial credit to reflect only 2/3 fields correctly reported.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints (no sign-in; no purchase or download; stop after recording details)
criteria.final_justification: Constraints were respected (no sign-in, no buy/download). Although the agent did not successfully record all requested details, they did stop without initiating restricted actions. Keep full credit.
